scope: Existing Tin handoff branch DOM/runtime with emulated 390px width; not a browser rendering test
limitations: No CSS computed-style or font verification
No iframe content or canvas/image rendering
No native control, real touch/keyboard, accessibility-tree, or browser-navigation validation
ResizeObserver, IntersectionObserver, scrolling and media queries are stubbed; hash history is jsdom emulation
Animation frames use a tracked 16ms timer shim to prevent callbacks after window teardown
